# AgentSee

> AgentSee is a marketing agency that markets to AI agents. We help companies get their
> brand and website ready for the agentic web — the growing share of discovery, research,
> and transactions now happening through AI agents acting on a human customer's behalf.
> We treat this as a full-funnel marketing problem, not an engineering problem: agents
> still move through discovery, research and education, and conversion — just faster.

## What we do

- **Agentic Readiness Audit** — a full diagnostic of how a brand shows up to AI agents across the funnel: where it's invisible at discovery, misrepresented in research, and unusable at conversion.
- **AEO & GEO Strategy** — content and positioning designed to earn citation and recommendation inside AI-generated answers (Answer Engine Optimization / Generative Engine Optimization).
- **Structured Data & Brand Content** — schema.org markup and brand-consistent content so agents can accurately research and represent a business.
- **API, MCP & WebMCP Enablement** — strategy and implementation support for exposing real business capabilities through interfaces agents can call (Model Context Protocol, WebMCP).

## The framework

The agentic customer journey has three stages, and AgentSee builds readiness across all of them:

1. **Discovery** — AEO, GEO
2. **Research & Education** — structured data & schema, brand-consistent content
3. **Conversion** — APIs & MCP, WebMCP

## Differentiator

AgentSee was built by marketers, not engineers who discovered AI. Most companies in this
space approach the agentic web as an engineering problem. AgentSee approaches it as a
marketing problem that happens to need some technical execution — full-funnel brand
strategy, applied to a funnel now run by agents.
